description: Execute multiple commands in one daemon request. Use it for a known multi-step walk, such as press A, press B, back, instead of one tool call per step. steps is an array of {command, input} objects; input takes the same arguments as that command's own tool (ref, selector, or x and y for targets; settle: true for the settled diff). Steps run serially in one session; onError: "stop" halts at the first failing step, and the result reports the steps that ran. The daemon stops the whole batch after 60 seconds; split longer walks. Example steps, in order (refs such as @e12 come from the last snapshot or settled diff): {"command":"press","input":{"ref":"@e12","settle":true}}, {"command":"press","input":{"selector":"label=Settings","settle":true}}, {"command":"fill","input":{"selector":"id=\"field-email\"","text":"qa@example.com"}}, {"command":"scroll","input":{"direction":"down","until":"label=Privacy","settle":true}}, {"command":"back","input":{"settle":true}}, {"command":"wait","input":{"kind":"text","text":"Saved"}}, {"command":"snapshot","input":{"interactiveOnly":true}}. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of steps accepted for this batch.

out.description: Optional output path for command artifacts.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

steps.description: Structured batch steps. Each step uses a command name and the same input object as that command tool.

command.description: Command name to run with structured input.

input.description: Structured command input for the nested command. Use the matching MCP tool schema for this object.

name: batch
title: Run multiple commands
